## getLocalConfigPath() function

Get the path to the local config file.

If a home directory override is set via setAttestItHomeDir(), returns {<!-- -->homeDir<!-- -->}<!-- -->/config.yaml. Otherwise returns \~/.config/attest-it/config.yaml.
